mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS 3-month % change > 2% and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative economic growth expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO 3-month % change < -1% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) above 1.3 million units signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 1.3 million units and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, which signals a restrictive monetary policy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a strong labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with strong job growth
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200k and UNRATE < 5% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real GDP (GDPC1) above 2% annualized rate signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 3-month annualized growth > 2% and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.
